# atlassian_confluence_space (Resource)

Manages a Confluence Cloud space.

## Required OAuth scopes

When the provider authenticates as a service account, its credential must carry the scopes for the operations this resource actually performs. A scope is checked when an operation runs, so a resource that is only ever read needs the first bullet alone.

- Read: `read:space:confluence`
- Create: `write:space:confluence`
- Update: `read:space-details:confluence`, `write:space:confluence`, `write:space.permission:confluence`
- Delete: `delete:space:confluence`, `read:content.metadata:confluence`

Managing a space through its whole lifecycle therefore needs all six. Creating one also requires a tenant with Role-Based Access Control enabled, which is what the v2 createSpace operation is gated behind.

> **Deletion is permanent**
> Deleting this resource deletes the space outright; it does not pass through the trash and cannot be undone.

> **Write-only at create**
> `template_key`, `copy_space_access_configuration`, `create_private_space` and `role_assignments` are sent only when the space is created. No read operation returns them, so they are never refreshed from the API and changing them always replaces the space.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "atlassian_confluence_space" "example" {
  key  = "DEMO"
  name = "Demo Space"

  description = {
    value = "Managed by Terraform"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the space. Maximum 200 characters.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Alias for the space in page URLs, used as the space's identifier when key is not set. Exactly one of key or alias is required. Immutable: changing it replaces the space. Maximum 255 alphanumeric characters.
- `copy_space_access_configuration` (String) ID of the space to copy the access configuration from. Write-only at create; see the resource description.
- `create_private_space` (Boolean) Whether to create the space as private. Write-only at create; see the resource description.
- `description` (Attributes) Space description. Only the plain representation is accepted on write. Removing this block from configuration does not clear the description on the API; the prior value is kept. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--description))
- `homepage_id` (String) ID of the space's homepage. Server-assigned at creation; updatable afterward.
- `key` (String) Key of the space. Exactly one of key or alias is required. Immutable: changing it replaces the space.
- `role_assignments` (Attributes Set) Role assignments seeded at creation. Write-only at create; see the resource description. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--role_assignments))
- `status` (String) Status of the space: current or archived. Updating this attribute is how a space is archived or unarchived. trashed cannot be set from configuration.
- `template_key` (String) Key of the template used to create the space. Write-only at create; see the resource description.
- `type` (String) Type of the space. Server-assigned at creation; updatable afterward, though valid transitions are undocumented.

### Read-Only

- `author_id` (String) Account ID of the user who created the space.
- `created_at` (String) Date and time the space was created, RFC 3339.
- `current_active_alias` (String) Currently active alias for the space.
- `id` (String) Numeric-string ID of the space.
- `space_owner_id` (String) Account ID of the user who owns the space. Absent on some responses.
